title: George Kittle says Brandon Aiyuk 'still got it' ahead of potential 49ers split

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: George Kittle says Brandon Aiyuk 'still got it' ahead of potential 49ers split
sources.description: San Francisco 49ers tight end George Kittle said Brandon Aiyuk appeared healthy but alluded to potential extra baggage for the Commanders.
